definition: dx->relapse change in genome-wide breakpoint count and fraction genome altered
data_source: EGA:EGAD00001011049 BriTROC-1 pilot (n=4 matched dx/relapse pairs, real sWGS/QDNAseq)
threshold_rationale: Data-anchored on the pilot: 3/4 pairs (subj 191:+253, subj 6:+101, subj 119:+18* ) show breakpoint gain; subj 109 (-7) is near-clonal/stable. Threshold +50 separates the two clearly divergent (191,6) from the stable (109). This is a DEMONSTRATION threshold from n=4 with a WIDE confidence interval — it MUST be re-estimated on the full 182-pair cohort before any clinical use.
subject_191_role: extreme divergence exemplar (delta +253, 65% genome altered) — the audit's 'smoking gun'
